title: Studio private audio rename UI
purpose: Expose the verified owner-authorized private audio rename PATCH through the creator Studio without introducing new storage, identity, project, public-media, or music-rights authority.
invariants: Rename controls are rendered only from already-sanitized private audio asset metadata.
Studio sends PATCH only to the authenticated private project audio item endpoint.
Client trims the requested name and rejects empty or greater-than-120-character values before the request.
Server remains authoritative for authorization and validation.
Studio never sends storageReference, revision, owner identity, creator identity, or project ownership hints.
Rename and delete controls are disabled while rename is in flight.
Sanitized private audio metadata is refreshed after successful rename.
No direct D1 or R2 access is introduced.
No public URL, download, sharing, publishing, master, management, copyright, collaborator, or royalty authority is introduced.
